review_basis: Frozen report input, grounded element statements, formal plan, deterministic P/I/V AST, validation output and solver output. Z3 success was not treated as semantic correctness. Rejected cases were reviewed at the element layer only; their formal ratings are not_evaluable because the pipeline emitted no formal artifact. A same-model heterogeneous-prompt dual review (DUAL_REVIEW.json) runs as a second opinion.

rating_scale.pass: faithful to the report and correctly scoped
rating_scale.partial: core direction is correct but a material condition, scope or observable relation is weakened or omitted
rating_scale.fail: misclassified, contradicted, circular or missing a critical report condition
rating_scale.not_evaluable: the pipeline did not emit the corresponding final artifact

summary.interpretation: Engineering completion held at 60% (6/10) with the sample doubled, and the layer that rejections occupy has moved again: none of the four rejections is the live2 constant-expression family. One is a new single-case misfire (a hex protocol constant 0x811 parsed as a numeric literal), two are correct catches of fabricated identities or unit products (the type/unit family that also killed live1's Hybra), and one is an honest input-screening abstain. The element layer stayed clean on every evaluable case with zero post-action observations in P, and formula I/V were exact in all six candidates. The two formula-P partials are the same defect shape: two distinct extracted facts sharing one repeated truth predicate, so one fact is silently unrepresented -- a reported-not-enforced check (identical_p_predicates) doing exactly its designed job of surfacing the defect without breaking frozen replay. This is an assistant review on n=10, not an expert gold standard, and it is not comparable to earlier batches except qualitatively (report sets are disjoint).

ratings.reason: P is three pre-action facts (rewards earned and held, token graduated, transfer triggers unstaking) with no post-action observation. The intent (rewards earned during bonding go to the user on transfer-unstake) and impact (rewards sent to the launchpad) are faithful; state_correspondence fits. Formula I is reward_recipient == user under the graduated-transfer condition, the unweakened recipient obligation; V is P with the misroute. Ambiguities honestly record the conditional narrative.

Elements are faithful (fixed initial totalSupply, broken totalAssets formula, massive-shares impact). Formula P binds totalSupply == 1000000 (a report literal) but encodes the totalAssets formula statement and the tiny-totalAssets statement with the SAME truth predicate tiny_total_assets, so the definitional statement stops being represented (the reported-not-enforced duplicate-predicate check surfaces exactly this). Formula I is the report's share formula cross-multiplied (shares_received * total_assets <= deposit * total_supply), a faithful amount-level restatement of a division; V is P with massive shares. Direction correct, one precondition collapsed.

P is two pre-action facts (validator-signed self-allowance active, victim holds covered shares). The intent carries the full authorization requirement and the condition encodes caller_is_owner_or_approved == false, so the live-1 subcase-narrowing defect did not recur. Relation forbids the victim-shares burn under that condition per the access_control impact-citing rule; V is P with an unauthorized burn. Faithful throughout.

Elements are faithful (permissionless re-initializable init, factory deploys and calls init once, attacker becomes builderAdmin). The first formalization attempt was rejected and the repair -- now able to rewrite the predicate under the widened numeric repair scope -- produced a candidate, the direct live-3 target. Formula P reuses the identical wallet_initialized truth predicate for both the wallet-exists and the factory-init-once statements, collapsing one fact (same duplicate-predicate shape as Panoptic Hypovault). Formula I is attacker_is_admin_after == false under the initialized, re-callable condition; V is P with the attacker becoming admin. Direction correct, one precondition collapsed.

P is the pre-action configuration (recipient contract set, validation logic reverts, operator claim path) plus the over-limit attempt as trigger context. claim_amount > 1000 uses the report's daily-limit literal. The intent (a recipient onClaim revert must abort the claim) and impact (validation bypassed, claim succeeds) are faithful; progress_or_liveness fits. Relation forbids claim success under the revert scenario; V is P with the claim succeeding. Faithful.

P is pre-action standing properties and scenario facts (permissionless rebalance, excess liquidity present, target buffer configured); the conditional nature of the excess-liquidity fact is honestly recorded as a scenario qualifier in unresolved rather than claimed as observed. The inferred least-privilege intent and the fast-redemption impact are faithful. Relation is the disjunction caller_is_authorized OR fast_redemption intact, which preserves the report's claim that only an unauthorized rebalance may disable the fast path; V is P with both disjuncts false. The narrowing of the condition to the permissionless-rebalance subcase follows the rule for reports that only establish the subcase, and limitations record the deferral of the other impacts and the symbolic authorization.

Elements are faithful (net-backing intent, mechanism narratives, supply/borrow facts). The numeric gate rejected the plan because a selected precondition narrates a protocol mechanism constant (registers 0x811 supplied slots) whose hex digits the literal scanner counts as a numeric literal, while the model reasonably declined to encode slot count 2065 as a P constraint. The repair changed limitations, pattern and precondition_terms but did not add the demanded predicate. This is a misfire of the strict P-source rule on hex protocol constants -- a new single-case family; under the parsimony rule (>=2 independent failures before a prompt change) it is recorded here and parked, not fixed.

Elements are faithful. The first plan defined expected_victim_shares = victim_deposit * total_supply as a derived symbol and compared it against plain shares, producing product-vs-share unit mismatch; the type/unit gate correctly rejected this fabricated structure (the faithful form is the cross-multiplied relation shares * total_assets <= deposit * total_supply, as the accepted Panoptic Hypovault plan shows the model can produce). The bounded repair then returned the plan unchanged and the no-change check rejected it: a model repair-discipline failure on the same type/unit family that killed live1's Hybra, not a gate misfire.

Elements are faithful (previewWithdraw liveness intent, two-deposit scenario). Attempt 1 was a malformed JSON (engineering noise). Attempt 2 encoded a curve identity total_assets = total_assets_factor * ... that the report does not state; the type/unit gate correctly rejected the fabricated definition, and retries did not repair it. Correct catch, same fabricated-identity family the gates exist for.

Input screening judged the report uncertain on safety_relation_basis (the report does not state a checkable safety relation) and the pipeline stopped before extraction. This is the honest-abstain path working as designed: no artifact was produced, so nothing is rated.
